_comment: Backend routes with no caller in production frontend code, and what was
integration-only — no UI by design (operator lever, external surface)
to-wire          — the UI is missing and should be built
to-delete        — superseded by a route the UI already calls
to-decide        — the product question is open
Only integration-only is a resting state. The other three are scheduled
work, and `expires` is what schedules it: past that date the gate fails and
names the owner. An entry with no reason, no owner or no date is refused.

/api/v1/admin/stats/activity.reason: Installation-wide admin activity metrics. No frontend screen renders them; they are read through the API.

/api/v1/admin/stats/ai-usage.reason: Token and cost accounting per AI purpose. No frontend screen renders it; it is read through the API.

/api/v1/admin/stats/summary.reason: Installation-wide counts across organizations. No frontend screen renders them; they are read through the API.

/api/v1/warehouse/documents/lookup/{numb.reason: Finds a document by its printed number. The document scanner resolves numbers through the scan registry instead, so this route serves external systems that hold a number from a printout and need the record.

/api/v1/warehouse/settings/type-configs.reason: Per-document-type configuration (numbering, defaults) with GET, PUT and DELETE. No settings screen calls it; it is configured through the API.

/api/v1/warehouse/settings/type-configs/.reason: Read, update and delete of one document type's configuration. No settings screen calls it.

/api/v1/warehouse/tax-rates.reason: Tax rate dictionary, create and list. No settings screen calls it; document lines carry the rate as entered.

/api/v1/warehouse/tax-rates/{rate_id}.reason: Read, update and delete for the tax rate dictionary. No screen calls it.

/api/v1/warehouse/tax-summary.reason: Tax totals per rate over a period. No report screen calls it.

/api/v1/warehouse/documents/{document_id.reason: Reads one picking session. The UI lists the sessions of a document and acts on one by id from that list, so it never fetches a single session.

/api/v1/equipment/protocol/placeholders.reason: Placeholder list for handover protocol templates. The template editor reads /equipment/templates/placeholders only, so these placeholders are not offered in the UI.

/api/v1/items/cursor-page.reason: Cursor pagination over items for external consumers and large exports. The UI pages by offset because it shows page numbers, which a cursor cannot provide. Both are canonical envelopes per AGENTS.md.

/api/v1/items/expiring.reason: Superseded by GET /items?expiring_days=N, which the item list and its expiry chip call.

/api/v1/items/product-templates/sku-sche.reason: GET and PUT for the organization's SKU numbering scheme. No screen calls it, so SKUs are entered free-form.

/api/v1/items/product-templates/{templat.reason: Duplicates a product template. The products UI has no clone action (equipment models have one, through their own route).

/api/v1/maker/bom/parents.reason: Lists templates that have BoM lines. The UI gets the same answer from /maker/bom/summary and /maker/bom/template-ids.

/api/v1/maker/bom/{line_id}.reason: DELETE of a BoM line. The editor deletes through the recipe-scoped /maker/recipes/{id}/bom-lines/{lineId} instead.

/api/v1/maker/bom/{template_id}.reason: Flat BoM lines for a template. The editor reads /maker/bom/tree/{id}, which returns the same lines with their structure.

/api/v1/organizations/current/defaults.reason: Operator lever: re-seeds the product profile's starting locations for an organization that lacks them. Enabled modules seed their own locations through system_on_enable, so no screen calls it.

/api/v1/partners/{partner_id}/items.reason: Items a partner supplies or has bought. The partner detail page shows documents and contact data and does not call it.

/api/v1/printing/agent/jobs/{job_id}/ima.reason: Called by the Inventari Print Agent (print-agent/agent.py, serve mode) on the machine next to a printer, never by the browser; a key with the printing scope reaches these paths and nothing else.

/api/v1/printing/agent/jobs/{job_id}/rep.reason: Called by the Inventari Print Agent (print-agent/agent.py, serve mode) on the machine next to a printer, never by the browser; a key with the printing scope reaches these paths and nothing else.

/api/v1/printing/agent/register.reason: Called by the Inventari Print Agent (print-agent/agent.py, serve mode) on the machine next to a printer, never by the browser; a key with the printing scope reaches these paths and nothing else.

/api/v1/printing/agent/{agent_id}/claim.reason: Called by the Inventari Print Agent (print-agent/agent.py, serve mode) on the machine next to a printer, never by the browser; a key with the printing scope reaches these paths and nothing else.

/api/v1/profiles/{profile_id}.reason: One product profile by id. The onboarding and settings screens list profiles and apply one; the packaging CLI is what addresses a single profile.

/api/v1/purchase-orders/import/analyze.reason: Reads a supplier file and proposes purchase order lines. Purchase orders have no import screen, so no UI calls it.

/api/v1/purchase-orders/{po_id}/approval.reason: Proxy that reads the approval request for an order. The detail page reads it from the approvals module directly, through useApprovalRequests.

/api/v1/purchase-orders/{po_id}/create-r.reason: Builds a confirmed receipt for an order in one call, for scripts and integrations that hand the floor a receipt to scan. The order screen receives through the one-screen receive, which posts with POST /warehouse/documents/post.

/api/v1/purchase-orders/{po_id}/html.reason: Renders an order as HTML for preview and printing. The purchase order screens do not call it.

/api/v1/purchase-orders/{po_id}/import-l.reason: Commits the lines proposed by /purchase-orders/import/analyze. No import screen calls it.

/api/v1/recipes/import.reason: The commit step of recipe import. The UI calls /recipes/import/preview only and has no confirm action that calls this route.

/api/v1/recipes/ingredient-defaults/seed.reason: Seeds the starter ingredient-to-product mapping for an organization. An operator lever, like the seed-defaults routes in purchase orders and equipment.

/api/v1/recipes/meal-plans/{plan_id}/ent.reason: Adds several meal plan entries in one call. The planner adds entries one request at a time.
Starts a picking session from a planned meal. The meal planner has no cook action that calls it.

/api/v1/roles/users/{user_id}/{role_id}.reason: Assigns a custom role by a path pair. The members list changes roles through the organization members endpoint, which also refuses an admin demoting themselves.

/api/v1/shopping-lists/{list_id}/suggest.reason: Accepts every shopping list suggestion in one call. The UI adds suggestions one by one.

/api/v1/stats/activity.reason: Recent activity feed. No dashboard screen calls it.

/api/v1/stats/consumption.reason: Consumption over time. No dashboard screen calls it.

/api/v1/stats/overview/stream.reason: Server-sent stream of the overview numbers, for a wallboard or an external dashboard. The dashboard polls the plain /stats/overview instead.

/api/v1/stats/shopping-suggestions.reason: Shopping suggestions from consumption history. The shopping lists module computes its own suggestions and the UI reads those.

/api/v1/stock-takes/cycle-count-schedule.reason: Cycle count schedules, list and create. The backend is complete and no screen calls it; schedules are created through the API only.
Cycle count schedules, read, update and delete. The backend is complete and no screen calls it; schedules are managed through the API only.

/api/v1/stock-takes/{stock_take_id}/item.reason: Submits many counted lines in one call. The counting screen posts one line per item.

/api/v1/location-types/{location_type_id.reason: Read, update and delete one storage type. The UI lists and creates storage types but does not call this route.
